name: PRO750
description: The PRO750 is Hooga's half-body red light therapy panel — a high-output device sized to treat the torso, back, or full front from head to hip in a single session. It delivers 660nm red and 850nm near-infrared wavelengths through 150 dual-chip LEDs , producing an irradiance of 183 mW/cm² at 6 inches. At 750W with a 20.4" x 8.6" footprint, the PRO750 is a serious step up from tabletop panels without committing to the space and price of a full-body setup. It ships with a door mount, adjustable pulley, and hanging wires so you can hang it from the back of most doors, or attach it to a Hooga mobile stand (sold separately). It has a built-in digital timer and digital control panel for red, near-infrared, or both. Why Dual-Chip LEDs Matter Each of the PRO750's 150 LEDs contains two chips — one emitting 660nm red light and one emitting 850nm near-infrared light. This means every LED delivers both wavelengths simultaneously, giving you a more even and consistent light output across the entire panel surface. Single-chip panels alternate red and NIR LEDs, which creates uneven coverage. Dual-chip eliminates that problem. Modular and Stand-Compatible The PRO750 is designed to grow with your setup. You can connect it to other PRO series panels (PRO300, PRO1500, PRO4500) on a Hooga mobile stand to build a wider or taller treatment area — useful if you start with a half-body panel and later want more coverage without replacing the device. Who the PRO750 Is For The PRO750 is a good fit if you want more coverage than a tabletop panel but don't need — or don't have room for — a full-body panel. It's commonly chosen by people focused on torso, back, or large-area recovery, and by people who want to start with half-body and add a second PRO panel later. If you know you want full-body from day one, look at the PRO1500 or PRO4500 instead. PRO Series vs. HG Series Hooga offers a comparable half-body panel in the HG line: the HG500 . The key difference is LED technology and output. The PRO750 uses 150 dual-chip LEDs delivering 183 mW/cm² at 6 inches, while the HG500 uses 100 single-chip LEDs delivering 94 mW/cm² at 6 inches. That's roughly double the LED count and double the irradiance. The PRO750 is also modular and stand-compatible with the rest of the PRO series, whereas the HG series does not stack. Both panels are backed by a 3-year warranty and a 60-day return window starting the day of delivery, plus free shipping (orders over $100). Returns are not free — return shipping is deducted from your refund.
